why_this_round_exists: The claim has been asked five times and the answer has held since r35. But one clause had never been tested end-to-end: 'after he does them at least once, he would learn all of those permanently'. Every prior learning test used the shipped skill or a fixture. This round teaches a genuinely NEW skill and measures all four properties.

the_four_properties__measured.1_learns_from_one_demonstration: YES -- compile_and_qualify_skill returned PASS__WORKFLOW_SKILL_COMPILED_QUALIFIED_AND_OWNED on a single trace
the_four_properties__measured.2_reaches_a_new_environment: YES -- the learned skill HIT on a database it was never trained on
the_four_properties__measured.3_survives_paraphrase: YES -- 'turn on the language option' reached a skill taught with those words; a paraphrase HIT; 'turn OFF...' correctly MISSED
the_four_properties__measured.4_permanent: PARTIAL -- the RECORD persists on disk across processes; the CAPABILITY does not always, and the reason is the defect below

the_defect.what_that_looks_like: a safety refusal, which reads as the system being careful
the_defect.what_it_actually_is: EXIT CODE 2 -- the command could not find its file. Confinement held the entire time (confined: True, live_workspace_untouched: True).
the_defect.why_it_matters: A skill compiled from a goal naming a repo-relative path stores an argv the carrier can never satisfy. The skill is correct, the store is correct, the carrier is correct, and the learned capability is still dead -- because nothing checked that they agree about what a path means. It fails as a SAFETY refusal, so it looks like care rather than inability.
the_defect.nothing_was_weakened_to_work_around_it: no confinement rule was changed; the finding is that path binding and carrier staging disagree

what_this_settles_about_the_thesis.fabrication: a learned skill is not a script -- it is a parameterized program with a postcondition and a held-out qualification gate
what_this_settles_about_the_thesis.generalisation: genuine but NARROW: it generalises across instances of the SAME operation (a different file, a different database), not across operations
what_this_settles_about_the_thesis.permanence: the bytes are permanent; permission to EXECUTE is re-established per call and can fail for reasons that have nothing to do with the skill
what_this_settles_about_the_thesis.exceeding_the_carrier: no -- still 37 read verbs, still no compile/build/install/fetch/write
what_this_settles_about_the_thesis.learning_a_new_KIND: no -- r36 measured 0 net saving across 10 never-seen kinds

the_shipped_skill_works_when_reachable.test: the one skill in the store, bound to a bare filename in its own workspace
the_shipped_skill_works_when_reachable.reading: the software is sound. The mismatch is a path-binding assumption, not a broken learner.

pinned_by: canonical/tests/test_a_skill_is_bound_where_the_carrier_can_reach_it_v1.py (6 tests): bare filename reachable, repo-relative NOT reachable, the shipped skill answers, survives paraphrase, refuses a different intent

the_answer_unchanged.general_environment_learning: bounded random walking; 81% coverage at 200 trials; goal never reached
the_answer_unchanged.any_computer_use: 37 read verbs, 33 installed; no compile, build, install, fetch, or write

smartest_next_moves__ranked.action: BIND PATHS AT THE CARRIER'S ROOT, NOT THE REPO'S
smartest_next_moves__ranked.why: this is the only thing between the measured learner and a working capability. It is a binding rule, not a new subsystem, and it is worth more than any further generalisation work because right now the shipped skill can only run from a workspace whose cwd happens to match.

smartest_next_moves__ranked.action: MAKE THE FAILURE LEGIBLE: exit 2 must not surface as a confinement refusal
smartest_next_moves__ranked.why: this defect hid for an unknown number of rounds behind a status string that means 'safety' when it meant 'file not found'. A refusal that misnames its cause costs more than a refusal.

smartest_next_moves__ranked.action: MEASURE THE STORE AGAIN AFTER RANK 1
smartest_next_moves__ranked.why: the honest question is how many of the 37 verbs can be taught, executed and replayed end-to-end. Today the answer is one, and only from a matching cwd.
